cases.question: According to RFC 5737, SHOULD NOT TEST-NET-1, TEST-NET-2 and TEST-NET-3 addresses appear on the public Internet?
gold_aspects: all three TEST-NET blocks SHOULD NOT appear on public Internet
false_claim_controls: TEST-NET approved for public production routing

cases.question: По RFC 2606 для чего зарезервирован домен верхнего уровня .invalid? Должны ли конструируемые с ним имена быть заведомо недействительными?
gold_aspects: .invalid intended for constructing obviously invalid domain names
false_claim_controls: .invalid reserved for ordinary public service hosting

cases.question: RFC 6238 recommends a default TOTP time-step size of 30 seconds. Is it a recommendation or a requirement that every implementation MUST use exactly30?
gold_aspects: not a universal MUST exactly30 from this recommendation
false_claim_controls: every TOTP implementation MUST use exactly30 seconds

cases.question: По RFC 7519 что требуется от текущего времени при проверке exp в JWT и разрешён ли небольшой leeway на clock skew?
gold_aspects: current time MUST be before expiration time when processing exp
small clock-skew leeway MAY be provided
false_claim_controls: exp valid when current time unconditionally after exp

cases.question: What happens to vectors x=[1] and y=[2, 3] after Rust std::mem::swap(&mut x, &mut y)?

cases.question: For a Rust iterator over [9, 8, 7, 6], what does skip(2) retain and are the first two items skipped?
false_claim_controls: skip returns first two values as retained result

cases.question: Rust slice::split_last для [4, 5, 6]: какой последний элемент и какой остаток возвращаются? Что для пустого slice?
Does RFC 7519 itself require every JWT to contain an exp claim, or is use of exp optional? Separate presence from validation when it is present.
gold_aspects: presence of exp OPTIONAL in base RFC7519
when present its expiration processing rule applies
false_claim_controls: base RFC7519 mandates exp in every JWT

cases.question: Если f паникует в Rust std::cell::OnceCell::get_or_init, паника превращается в возвращаемый Err или передаётся вызывающему? Остаётся ли ячейка неинициализированной?
gold_aspects: initializer panic propagates, not returned Err
false_claim_controls: get_or_init converts panic into returned Err

const form since1.83, not stable const on1.70
